externalSources.fact: §15.4.8: on a 307 a user agent MUST NOT change the request method if it redirects automatically; §15.4.3/§15.4.2: 302 and 301 may historically change POST to GET (GET is unaffected); §10.2.2: Location is a URI reference and may be relative; §14.2 Range and §14.1 range units ("bytes"); §14.4: Content-Range = range-unit SP (incl-range "/" (complete-length / "*") / "*/" complete-length), and a 206 or 416 carries it; §15.3.7: a client MUST inspect a 206 response's Content-Range to learn what part is enclosed and whether more requests are needed, and a server may send fewer bytes than asked; §15.5.17: 416 Range Not Satisfiable; §13.1.5: If-Range makes a server ignore Range unless the validator matches; §7.2: a user agent sends Host (or :authority).

HEAD at the hub answers 302 with Location on host us.aws.cdn.hf.co (a signed, short-lived URL), x-repo-commit 68f27dfe5a27a54fb2b1fefc432f43f972e90868, x-linked-size 1685258240 and x-linked-etag "487746363a8da57bcadb4345352997d22a0fb90d70aa22c6856668d023242aba" (the manifest's size and SHA-256), accept-ranges bytes. At the CDN target a GET with Range: bytes=0-15 answers 206 with content-range "bytes 0-15/1685258240", content-length 16 and accept-ranges bytes; a HEAD without Range answers 200 with content-length 1685258240. The CDN's own etag ("b06b05a0a887610c53a917603bb6986d8018400a2ec99158ac1cc944b55a24ed") is not the file's SHA-256.

a non-LFS file answers 307 with a relative Location on the same host (/api/resolve-cache/models/receptron/laya-onnx/68f27dfe5a27a54fb2b1fefc432f43f972e90868/laya_config.json plus a query), then 200 with 369 bytes whose SHA-256 is 5049005dc6ae3ca5e82cc7d85c421357d5c543817300c8e8c5281ddbc69bb561 (the manifest's value).
